comment: Ratchet guardrail against silent complexity drift, not a hard cap.
Each number is the current measured value. If a change genuinely needs to
grow a file, raise the number here in the SAME pull request: that keeps
growth a conscious, visible, reviewed decision instead of silent drift.
The intent is downward — when a file shrinks, lower its numbers so the
ceiling follows it down. Only files with a demonstrated regrowth risk are
listed; this is deliberately not applied to every large file.
Metrics: maxLines = physical line count; maxHooks = total React hook calls
See docs/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md > Architecture gate assertion forms.
